name: ccusage
what: CLI over local ~/.claude JSONL: daily, weekly, monthly, session and 5-hour billing-block reports; per-model cost breakdown; cache creation and cache read tokens tracked separately; per-project grouping; statusline (beta); JSON output; offline pricing; MCP server.
idea_we_lack: 5-hour billing-block grouping with an active-block view, and a statusline cost readout per seat. Confirm which of these our ledger already has.

name: Claude-Code-Usage-Monitor
what: Live monitor: 5h rolling session blocks, burn rate (tokens per minute from the last hour of all sessions), depletion and session-expiry predictions, P90-derived custom plan limits from the last 192h, pace labels and forecasts (v4). Uses statusline official rate-limit data when fresh and labels local estimates otherwise; 7-day percentages only from official data.
idea_we_lack: Burn rate in tokens per minute with a projected time-to-limit, and inferring a personal limit from the 90th percentile of past blocks instead of a fixed plan table. Also the rule that official rate-limit numbers beat local estimates, with the estimate labelled.

name: Claude Code native OpenTelemetry metrics and events
what: Built-in OTel (beta). Metrics: claude_code.cost.usage (USD, split by model, query_source main/subagent/auxiliary, speed, effort, agent.name, skill.name, plugin.name, mcp_server.name, mcp_tool.name); claude_code.token.usage split by type input/output/cacheRead/cacheCreation with the same attributes; session.count (start_type); active_time.total (user vs cli); code_edit_tool.decision. Events: api_request (per call: cost_usd, cache tokens, duration_ms, query_source, skill and MCP attribution); tool_result (success, duration_ms, tool_input_size_bytes, tool_result_size_bytes, error_type; full params with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1).
idea_we_lack: Read these native signals instead of parsing transcripts: query_source separates subagent and auxiliary spend, skill.name and mcp_tool.name give per-skill and per-MCP-tool cost, and tool_result sizes give a per-tool byte cost proxy. Also active_time for seat utilisation.

name: Grafana dashboard 25052 (Claude Code)
what: Grafana dashboard for Claude Code OTel metrics. Only seen in search results; panels not opened.
idea_we_lack: A ready-made Prometheus/Grafana view of the native OTel cost and token metrics, if we decide to run a collector. Panels still to check.

name: ccmeter
what: Reads ~/.claude/projects logs. Cache hit rate and trend; cache busts with dollars wasted; busts caused by idle gaps; sessions over 90 min that lost cache value; per-session cost, duration, bust count; per-tool cost (Bash, Read, ...); output tokens per dollar per turn; what-if model-swap and cache-TTL simulations; monthly budget projection and notify.
idea_we_lack: Cold-cache waste named by cause (idle gap vs long session), dollars per tool call, and a what-if replay for model swap or cache TTL on our own data. Directly matches our cold-cache rewrite category.

name: cc-lens
what: Local dashboard over ~/.claude: cache-savings estimate, Insights page with cache and model-overpayment suggestions, tool and skill usage ranking, session replay (tool calls, costs, compactions), per-project spend, languages, branches, MCP and agent usage. Pricing table overridable in ~/.cc-lens/pricing.json.
idea_we_lack: Per-project breakdown with branches and languages, a session replay that marks compactions next to cost, and a user-overridable pricing file so price changes need no code edit.

name: tokenscope
what: Read-only context attribution: spend split into cache read, cache write, output and fresh input (example: 66/18/16); per-turn context size with peak, average and current; cost by model and subagent; waste hints (re-sent context, suggests /compact). scan --max-total and --max-delta exit 1 when exceeded. Per-tool and per-file attribution listed only as roadmap.
idea_we_lack: Context-size gates that exit non-zero (usable as a harness check or pre-commit guard), and a per-session cost share by category to show how much is re-sent context.

name: sniffly
what: Local dashboard: usage stats, error breakdown by error type, message-history review and sharing. No cost-per-tool or per-project metrics found.
idea_we_lack: Error-type classification of tool failures and retry loops, which could feed our read-only loop waste category. Cost is not its focus.

name: claude-code-log
what: Converts transcript JSONL to HTML and a terminal UI; reports token usage tracking and a timeline. Star count from an aggregator, not the repo page.
idea_we_lack: Per-session HTML timeline with tool calls next to tokens, for human review of a waste case. Low priority for cost.
